details:
Q1 What concrete repo area should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow/script/prompt; provide path/name and problem. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation only; provide target page/section and desired update.
C. Tests/CI reliability; provide failing check, workflow, or expected pass condition.
D. Let the planner choose one small, low-risk improvement in the AI workflow tooling.
Q2 What outcome should count as success?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug; provide current behavior and expected behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or improve a named feature; describe the intended behavior.
C. Improve maintainability/observability; provide the signal or acceptance criteria.
